newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African state broadcaster in move to cut losses.
newsitem.headline: S.African state broadcaster in move to cut losses.

text.p: The South African Broadcasting Corp on Monday detailed steps to fight deepening losses but said the restructure would result in jobs being cut.
The SABC said in a statement it had accepted proposals which, if implemented, could save the corporation 450 million rand and boost advertising revenue by 340 million.

"However, the savings will also mean that up to 1,400 jobs will be lost," the SABC said, adding that management and the relevant labour unions would over the next three weeks hold talks on the implications of the review.
Steps would be taken to restructure both television and radio programmes.

"Faced with a new competitive environment, the SABC is having to reassess our structures and processes...There is no alternative. To make no cuts would mean the SABC running at a deficit for the foreseeable future," it said.
